text.div: Re-evaluation: walking distance increased from 80 to 160 meters. Goal is 250 meters without a rest; continue the current program.
Same-episode re-evaluation dated July 1: walking distance remained 80 meters with no measurable gain. This contradicts the reported 160 meters; no correction is documented.

policy.title: Synthetic PT Progress Narrative Assessment
policy.source: Research fixture, not a payer coverage policy
policy.narrative: Additional PT documentation is sufficient when a recent re-evaluation explicitly records measurable improvement toward a functional goal and an ongoing unmet goal. A procedure code, attendance, or a recommendation alone is insufficient. Conflicting or ambiguous accounts require review.

requirements.description: Recent re-evaluation explicitly documents measurable improvement toward a functional goal and an ongoing unmet goal. Attendance, a procedure code, and a recommendation alone do not demonstrate progress. Conflicting or ambiguous accounts require clinical review.
